sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:9

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:9:1
items.html:
The Gevurot that emerged in the world first, as the verse says, “In the beginning Elokim created,” etc.: This turns upon what our sages said (Bereshit Rabba, end of Chapter 12): at first it arose in thought to create the world with the quality of judgment, and He saw that the world would not endure, so He gave precedence to the quality of mercy and joined it with the quality of judgment; see there. And we have already spoken of this at length above (page 210, Inner Light, item 4), and it was explained there that in the first three Partzufim of AK there was but a single vessel of the aspect of Malchut, which is the quality of judgment, and therefore there was in them but a single line. And in order that the world should endure according to His will to do good to His created beings — which can be pictured only in a conduct of reward and punishment, in the secret of the ten utterances and the correction of the three lines, Hesed, judgment and mercy — this came about by the force of the joining of the quality of mercy with judgment. Its meaning is the joining of the first Hey, which is called the quality of mercy, namely Bina, with the bottom Hey, which is called the quality of judgment, namely Malchut. And the beginning of this joining was made in the coupling of the Rosh of SAG, for the sake of the world of Nekudim, in the secret of the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim and of YHV in the AHP, as written at length in Part 6. And this sufficed only for the correction of the lines in the GAR alone, but in the ZAT there was as yet no correction of lines there, and therefore the vessels of the ZAT were broken and fell into BYA, as written there at length.
And although the joining of the quality of mercy with judgment in the GAR did not suffice to correct the ZAT completely, that is, also from the side of the Hassadim, still the joining in the GAR of Nekudim availed to correct the ZAT from the side of the Gevurot. For although the vessels of the ZAT were broken and fell into BYA, sparks nevertheless descended with them in order to give life to the vessels; and know that these sparks mean the correction of the Gevurot, that they should be ready to receive the Hassadim afterwards, at the time when they are sorted and rise from there to Atzilut in the secret of MAN. And this is what he says, “that these seven kings are the Gevurot that emerged in the world first, as the verse says, ‘In the beginning Elokim created’” — namely the correction of the Gevurot, that they should be fit to be sorted and to be raised in the secret of MAN, to receive the Hassadim of the new MA. And these are hinted at in the secret of the verse, “In the beginning Elokim created,” for the name Elokim indicates Gevurot, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:9:2
items.html: He joined the quality of mercy with it, “on the day that HaVaYaH Elokim made”: This is the verse, “These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, on the day that HaVaYaH Elokim made earth and heaven.” (Genesis 2, verse 4) For the name HaVaYaH hints at the Hassadim, which is the king Hadar, called the new MA, as he writes further on. For through the raising of MAN from the sortings of the sparks and the vessels that are in BYA to Atzilut, they cause an upper coupling there and receive the illumination of the Hassadim of the new MA; and then the desired joining of the quality of mercy with judgment is completed, that is, through this the correction of the lines is completed in the ZAT as well. And all this will be explained in its place at length, God willing.
